svg.title: Bubble regions in one pangenome graph
svg.desc: A schematic pangenome graph with three annotated regions. Arrow-shaped nodes show DNA sequence orientation, and links can be followed in either direction. Region a, between u and v, contains alternative A and G sequences and is both an ultrabubble and a snarl. Region b, between v and w, has a loop and a sequence drawn in reverse orientation. It is a snarl. Region c, between w and x, is a d-bubble with an extra link from the surrounding graph back to an internal node. Braces label the regions, which share boundary nodes.
